author: The Infographics Show
description:
China is hiding the biggest real estate collapse in history. Tens of millions of apartments are empty or unfinished, major developers have defaulted, and Chinese families have watched trillions of dollars in property wealth disappear. What once powered China’s economic rise has become a financial trap threatening the middle class, local governments, and the global economy.

This video examines China’s ghost cities, the collapse of Evergrande and Country Garden, the pre-sale housing model, and the enormous shadow debt hidden inside Local Government Financing Vehicles. For decades, families placed most of their savings into property while local governments became dependent on land sales to fund public services and infrastructure.
When Beijing introduced the Three Red Lines policy, credit dried up and the property pyramid began to collapse. Millions of buyers were left paying mortgages on homes that may never be completed, while falling prices weakened consumer spending and pushed younge
title: It's NOT Just Real Estate. China is DEAD Right NOW.
